QuestInfo.name: Taking the Center
QuestInfo.0: The city center is in your grasp. Talk to #bEdea#k.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the remaining enemies and reclaim the city center.\r\n#r(Since this is a battlefield quest, you must forfeit the quest and restart if you fail.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You reclaimed the city center. Speak with Edea in the Downtown Black Market.

1.0: That battle was... bracing. But it was the biggest step we've taken yet towards retaking Heliseum.\r\n

yes.0: We may have won here today, but the war isn't over yet. The enemy still has reserves waiting to face us.\r\n
yes.1: #bPiston#k is working on that particular problem. Go help him. I need to devise our next strategy.\r\n

default.0: It's time we take the city center once and for all. Ready?\r\n#r(You must forfeit the quest and restart if you fail.)#k\r\n
